title: Total the Last K Marks
description: Return the total of the final k marks, or all marks when k is larger.

off_by_one: Think about where the final segment starts.
The selected segment should contain exactly k positions.
Check both a one-item segment and the full list.
unhandled_short_input: Consider what an empty collection contributes.
The operation should still have a numeric identity.
Test no marks before testing several marks.
An empty total should not require an index.
k_larger_than_list: Compare the requested amount with the available amount.
Selecting too much should not invent positions.
Use the available collection when the request is larger.
Check a one-item list with a much larger request.
k_zero: The result should be the additive identity.
Do not accidentally include the final item.
Try zero on a non-empty list.

explanations.k_zero: The zero case includes no marks.
explanations.k_larger_than_list: A request larger than the list should use every available mark.
explanations.empty_list: An empty list has no marks to add.
explanations.normal: The final segment did not match the requested size.
explanations.exact_boundary: The boundary where k equals the list size needs careful handling.
